reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Regular park visits are associated with measurable differences in children's mental health.
Minority language speakers continue to face prejudice in different European settings.
Schools can reduce some learning gaps while advantages linked to family wealth persist.
Online communities can be valuable spaces for autistic young people.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: Many autistic young people use online communities because local groups do not always accommodate different communication and sensory needs.

questions.prompt: Why might autistic young people struggle to find local groups for their interests?
options: Every community already has a club for every possible interest.
Their interests can be specialised enough that no nearby group exists.
Their interests are necessarily identical to everyone else's.
The article says autistic young people cannot form communities.
questions.explanation: 第 3 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: These interests can often be quite niche and so there may not be any local clubs or groups.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 9?
options: Restricting social media will not make public transport easier to use, youth clubs more welcoming or local venues less overwhelming.
Although online interactions are not free of misunderstanding, for some autistic young people they provide a form of social contact that is more manageable than many physical settings.

However, participants on the upper age range of our sample (24-26) reported the same issues with those on the lower age range, suggesting that these harms are linked less to young people’s use of platforms than to how they are designed.
I often need long posts to explain things, and it’s quite easy to find posts about specific topics.
questions.explanation: 定位第 9 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: I often need long posts to explain things, and it’s quite easy to find posts about specific topics.

questions.prompt:
Which paragraph contains the following information?
“However, participants on the upper age range of our sample (24-26) reported the same issues with those on the lower age range, suggesting that these harms are linked less to young people’s use of platforms than to how they are designed.”
options: Paragraph 15
Paragraph 11
Paragraph 14
Paragraph 3
questions.explanation: 这句话位于第 14 段。先找关键词，再核对上下文；正文页显示相同的段落编号。
questions.evidence: However, participants on the upper age range of our sample (24-26) reported the same issues with those on the lower age range, suggesting that these harms are linked less to young people’s use of platforms than to how they are designed.

questions.prompt:
Which paragraph contains the following information?
“Although many of our participants wanted to attend more in-person activities, they were’t always able to do so.”
options: Paragraph 17
Paragraph 4
Paragraph 11
Paragraph 16
questions.explanation: 这句话位于第 17 段。先找关键词，再核对上下文；正文页显示相同的段落编号。
questions.evidence: Although many of our participants wanted to attend more in-person activities, they were’t always able to do so.
